- Updated license and attribution: now credits Ben Sigman, Igor Lins e Silva, Milla Jovovich, and adv3nt3.
- No functional or protocol changes; documentation only.

Version 1.3.0

- Added explicit author attribution in the License & Attribution section ("created by Milla & Ben ([@igorls])").
- No functional changes to the skill code; documentation only.

- Added a "License & Attribution" section with full MIT license text and attribution to MemPalace contributors.
- No changes to protocol, tool descriptions, or usage instructions.

- Updated to version 1.1.0.
- Description clarified with product branding ("MemPalace — Local AI memory...").
- No functional or protocol/tool changes—documentation and presentation improvements only.
- No user-facing commands, setup, or usage instructions were changed.

- Initial release of mempalace: a local AI memory system with 96.6% recall and top LongMemEval performance.
- Semantic search and powerful filtering for fast context recall from conversation history.
- Temporal knowledge graph tracks facts, entities, and their changes over time.
- Organizes memories hierarchically as wings (e.g., people, projects), rooms, and drawers.
- All features run locally: no cloud, no API keys, full user control and privacy.
- Includes session diary, palace graph traversal, and advanced fact management tools.
